pages.text: Withered Forest, Ashen Wastes, Marrow Thicket and vanilla biomes. Only a $(l)mausoleum$() shows on the surface. Its stairs lead to the $(l)upper crypt$(): a ring gallery lined with skulls, four side crypts and a chapel (spawners, chests, mimics).
From the south gallery, a second staircase goes down to the $(l)deep crypt$(): two ossuaries and the tomb of the $(l)Withered Champion$(). The sealed vault lies north of the tomb.
